description: This file implements authentication services for a backend application, including user signup, login, token issuance, and token refresh functionalities. It interacts with a MongoDB database via Motor and utilizes security functions for hashing and token management.

methods.name: str signup(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, email: str, password: str, name: str, role: str = "student")
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database with provided email, password, name, and role, and returns the user ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] authenticate(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials against stored data and returns user info if valid.

methods.name: dict issue_tokens(user_id: str)
methods.description: Generates new access and refresh tokens for the specified user ID.

methods.name: dict refresh_tokens(refresh_token: str)
methods.description: Issues new access and refresh tokens based on a valid refresh token.
